banglaExplanation: সব কিছু চোখে দেখে যাচাই করা যায় না, তখন oral questioning লাগে।
এটা দিয়ে observations যাচাই হয়, underpinning knowledge check হয়।
Contingency questions দেখে প্রার্থী হঠাৎ সমস্যায় কী করবে, যেমন equipment broke down হলে।
আরও আছে extension, নিরাপত্তা, নিয়মকানুন আর reflective questions।

example.bn: মেশিন হঠাৎ নষ্ট হলে কী করবেন? এটাই contingency question।
example.en: An assessor asks a welding trainee: "What would you do if the machine broke down?"

Observation-এ যা দেখা গেছে তা ঠিক কি না, প্রশ্ন করে নিশ্চিত হওয়া যায়।

extra.text: Tell the 6 types apart: Extension = similar but different case; Contingency = breakdown or emergency; Safety = precautions; Infrequent = rare but critical; Regulations = rules and steps; Reflective = look back and improve.

short.modelAnswer:
Contingency questions check what a candidate does when something goes wrong. Examples:
1. What would you do if ...? (equipment broke down or something malfunctioned)
2. What would you do in the event of ...? (accident or emergency)
3. What would you do if ...? (complaint was made or conflict occurred)
4. How do you avoid ...? (preventative safety measure)

realQuestions.answer:
Oral questioning is useful when observation is not possible, to
verify observations, to test underpinning knowledge, or to explore competency
dimensions such as contingency management and problem-solving.
realQuestions.label: Short Questions (Short 53)
realQuestions.question: When is oral questioning useful in assessment?

realQuestions.answer:
• What would you do in the event of ...? (accident or emergency)
• What would you do if ...? (Equipment broke down or something malfunctioned)
• What would you do if ... (complaint was made or conflict occurred)
• How do you avoid ...? (preventative safety measure)
